reason: Full independent review against all 358 lines of the assigned raw at verified SHA-256 4dc37e6068537d60bdfbf927d35b4bd3ceca5c05f35b6d927b1abc6b0320e3d0, CLAUDE.md, rules/ingest.md, rules/psp/metronome.md, the Campaign 23 Minimum Sufficient Source playbook, all attempt artifacts, and the complete current Product Get/List/archive, product guide, SQL billable-metric, custom-field, invoicing, and API-wide idempotency authorities found the mechanical evidence sound and the POST execution-admission boundary correctly preserved, but six material semantic clusters remain. Candidate and receipt are byte-identical, suggestions and receipt agree, the canonical target is absent, the canonical URL, raw_files value, and exact path-qualified raw backlink match the campaign, all five excerpts are exact at their stated raw lines, every existing wikilink and proposed anchor resolves uniquely, and deterministic wiki validation passes. The blocker-completeness pass across every coverage-map category and primary route found: the candidate overstates the generic success Id as created-product identity and misstates nullable nested configuration requiredness; it omits the create-versus-read product-type contract; it misses a current guide contradiction over composite selectors; it presents the create schema's service-period SQL default without the current SQL guide's opposite hour default or the missing read-back surface; it leaves the primary custom-field route without the current contract_product naming, persistence, and invoice-line propagation authority; and it omits the materially relevant at-least-24-hour and persisted-HTTP-500 portions of API-wide retry behavior. These are core response, requiredness, enum, default, pricing-timing, custom-field, invoice, and failure-authority defects, so the retry must remain full. No other material blocker is currently visible.
required_changes: Correct the immediate request/response schema treatment. The HTTP 200 schema requires data.id through a generic Id object but does not explicitly label that UUID as the created Product resource rather than another result identity, so remove the overview's definitive 'its UUID' claim and preserve the identity ambiguity. Also state that quantity_conversion and quantity_rounding are nullable: only a supplied non-null object requires conversion_factor plus operation or rounding_method plus decimal_places; a supplied null does not trigger those nested required lists.

Preserve the full product-type authority mismatch. The create request enum accepts upper- and lowercase forms of FIXED, USAGE, COMPOSITE, and SUBSCRIPTION plus client-annotated PROFESSIONAL_SERVICE and PRO_SERVICE forms, while current Get and List responses expose only the five uppercase values USAGE, SUBSCRIPTION, COMPOSITE, FIXED, and PRO_SERVICE, and the product guide documents only four product types. Link the current Get/List authorities and do not infer response spelling, round-trip normalization, creation support, or general tenant availability for either professional-service label.

Add the composite-selector contradiction. The create schema descriptions call both composite_product_ids and composite_tags required for a COMPOSITE product even though neither appears in the schema required array, while the current product guide says a composite selects applicable products by ID or product tag. Preserve all three source-scoped surfaces without concluding that both arrays, either array, or one-at-least validation is the runtime rule; revise the products-and-rate-cards proposal accordingly.

Add the material SQL granularity contradiction and read-back boundary. This create raw says service_period is the default and hour is recommended, whereas the current SQL Editor authority says hour is the default and service period is opt-in; the latter also shows that the choice changes when usage cost is incurred, which rate applies, and whether a credit or commit covers the final instant. Current Product Get/List schemas do not expose sql_breakdown_granularity, so they do not establish how to verify the selected value. Add the SQL Editor evidence route, a reciprocal contradiction warning, and revise the billable-metrics proposal rather than inserting an unqualified service-period default into a concept that currently records hour.

Complete the primary custom-field and invoice route. The Product-create raw accepts an optional open string-valued custom_fields map but carries no entity annotation. Current dedicated authority creates product fields with entity contract_product, says values can be set during object creation, persist and are returned across app/API/export surfaces, and propagate from a product to its associated invoice line; the create-key enum separately exposes both product and contract_product without reconciling them, and Product Get/List annotate their returned map contract_product. Preserve the known persistence and invoice-line behavior with its timing, configured-key, propagation, and downstream limits, explicitly retain the product-versus-contract_product naming boundary, link the create-key and Get/List authorities, and revise or add fact-bearing custom-field and invoicing reciprocal proposals.

Keep the correctly stated POST execution-admission boundary, but complete the material API-wide failure contract in the candidate and idempotency proposal: an admitted persisted result is retained for at least 24 hours, can be an HTTP 500, and the same key replays that cached error, so ambiguous state must be investigated rather than treating a changed key as automatically safe. Keep validation failures and pre-execution concurrent-request conflicts outside established cached results and keep no-key, another-key, expired-key, product uniqueness, concurrency ordering, propagation, visibility, and endpoint-specific recovery unknown.

shared_update_decisions.reason: It treats data.id as created-product identity and omits the create-versus-read enum mismatch and the guide's contradictory composite selector semantics.

It inserts an unqualified service-period default despite the current SQL Editor authority documenting hour as the default and omits the material timing, pricing, credit-or-commit, and read-back boundary.
It omits the contract_product versus product entity-name boundary and the dedicated authority's established persistence, retrieval, and invoice-line propagation semantics.
Its execution-admission condition is correct, but the proposed retry fact omits at-least-24-hour retention, persisted HTTP 500 replay, and the resulting ambiguous-state investigation boundary.
